data: What is the value of total meeting time, of the red line, when 90 meetings have been held in the top plot?

The question asks for the value of the total meeting time, represented by the red line, when 90 meetings have been held. From the caption, we can see that the red line represents the total meeting time. The x-axis shows the number of meetings, and the y-axis shows the time in minutes. By looking at the graph, we can see that when the x-axis reaches 90, the corresponding y-axis value for the red line is approximately 45 minutes. Therefore, the value of the total meeting time when 90 meetings have been held is approximately 45 minutes.
